about: Everything planned for Plannr that isn't built yet: the single list to move, rename or delete from.
kind 'stub': a placeholder file on disk whose first line is a 'PLANNED (milestone): purpose' comment.
kind 'generated': made later by a tool (dotnet new, create-expo-app, dotnet ef); listed but deliberately not on disk.
'connects' names what an entry will talk to: other entries, or real files already in the repo.
'question' is an open design decision to settle before building it.
StructureManifestTests (backend/tests/Plannr.Tests/Structure) fails on hanging, missing or broken entries.
When a stub is built: remove its PLANNED line and its entry here. When a tool creates a 'generated' path: remove its entry.

milestones.M2: Data pool tooling in Eval (snapshot, labels, G3 scoring)
milestones.M3: API skeleton: EF Core + MySQL, Identity + JWT, cards
milestones.M4: Capture loop: POST /captures -> Captures table -> Worker -> card -> SignalR
milestones.M5: Mobile shell: Expo dev build, login, API client, share intent
milestones.M6: TikTok retrieval; screenshots end to end in the app
milestones.M8: Tests, G3 on the held-out set, MVP (11 Dec 2026)
milestones.T2: Term 2 sprints: Should features and the AWS deploy
